input.title: Unisex Pickleball – My Partner Says It Was Out. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This pickleball zip up hoodie is for the pickleball player whose partner has never once agreed that the ball was in, zipped on for the early court time and the long argument after.

A young man in a headband and a mustard sweater points down at a pickleball on the court line while a woman in a cap and a striped top stands behind him holding a paddle, on a red and cream court, in mustard, navy, red and cream with a worn print texture. MY PARTNER SAYS runs above it in two lines and IT WAS OUT. below in tall condensed capitals, the last line wider than the first: cream and mustard on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small IT WAS over OUT. wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word PARTNER is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest IT WAS OUT. wordmark and left-cuff PARTNER, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the My Partner Says It Was Out. zip hoodie fit?
The My Partner Says It Was Out. pickleball zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this pickleball hoodie warm enough for cool morning courts?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool morning courts, windy open play and the walk to the parking lot well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, MY PARTNER SAYS above the court scene and IT WAS OUT. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small IT WAS over OUT. wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and PARTNER is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The IT WAS OUT. wordmark on the chest and the PARTNER cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a pickleball player, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the player who is always sure the ball was in and always outvoted. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
